exact_contract: Strict exact fields,pinned profile/catalog hashes;schema_version/profile.version/market.version/question_version exactinteger1. Opaque IDs ASCII1..64. One market,accounts1..8 distinct,events0..512. Outcomes exactly[YES,NO],exhaustive=true,money_unit=play_credit. Nonempty definition/positive_rule/negative_rule<=4000characters. No actual money or external services.

All input numeric parameters/credits/quantities are decimal STRINGS,not numbers/bools/Fractions. Canonical optional minus,integer0 or1..10digits,no exponent/leadingzero/negativezero. Liquidity/shares <=8fractional places;credits<=24places. b in[0.01,1000000];initial credits in[0,1000000000];trade delta nonzero withabs<=1000000000. Quotes constrain each projected quantity to[0,1000*b]. Initial positions andpricing quantities alwayszero.

Use an explicit independent Decimal Context precision80,ROUND_HALF_EVEN,Emin=-999999,Emax=999999;trap invalid/divzero/overflow/float operation. No global-context dependence. Transcendentals approximate; cash-grid arithmetic exact under bounded magnitudes. Numerical price/cost verification tolerance absolute1e-60 against independent Decimal120 direct-exp oracle;cash charges exactquantum equality.

Max-shift cost andbothsoftmax numerators required. Each modeled price positive;sum within1e-60 of1. Extreme dominant price mayroundto1 whilecomplement remainspositive; do not derive complement by1-dominant orclaim exact-real normalization. Allowed q_i/b<=1000 avoids Decimal exponent underflow. No naive binaryfloat exponential.

Quantize TOTAL cost potential to1e-24 HALF_EVEN before differencing;never separately round ideal incremental charges. Compute reserve CEILING_grid(b*ln(2)+2*quantum). Ideal b ln2 bound isapproximate numeric output;funded grid reserve explicitlycovers quantization/numerical margin. No realcapital provision implied.

UTC-Z created_at<close_at;all delivery times>=created_at andnondecreasing,withtiesallowed. Validate all event syntax/time ordering before any action. Trades andquotes require delivery_at<close_at,strict boundary unlike inclusive51/57forecast cutoffs. At firstevent time>=close_at,clock automatically closes anopen market before processing theaction;no reopening.

quote action hasactor,unique quote_id,outcomeYES/NO,signeddelta. It stores current economicrevision andhypothetical old/new roundedpotentials/charge andprice diagnostics. It can show infeasible budget/owned-position constraints,butdoesnot reserve cash,execute or mutate positions/financialledger. Unknown actor orprojected globalquantity outsidebounds is anaction refusal.

execute action references storedquote_id andsameactor. Reject unknown/used/stale quote,closed/resolved market,insufficient usercredit,negative ownposition ormaker funding. Recheck constraints atomically before state mutation. Successful execute updates user/maker cash,one outcome position,pricingquantity andeconomicrevision together;marksquoteused andappends one immutable hash-chained financialentry. No naked shorting,leverage,fees,deposits ortransfers.

Event ID binds canonical intent excluding delivery at only;firstresult isimmutable. Repeated same intent ID atsame/laterdeclaredtime is idempotent_noop withoriginal decision,no duplicated financialeffect. Conflicting IDreuse is rejected. Retries ofpreviousrefusals also cannot acquire neweffect;use new ID/fresh quote. Clock-driven closure canstilladvance nonfinancial marketstatus.

close action requires actor==declared resolver andtime>=close_at;otherwiseactionrefusal. Explicit close is optional becauseclock closure enforcescutoff. Resolver identity equality is a declared offline convention,not cryptographic/external authentication.

resolve action requires declared resolver,delivery>=close_at,outcomeYES/NO,andnotalreadyresolved. Settle exactlyonce:pay everyaccount itswinning recordedshares,subtracttotalpayout frommaker,andappend hash-chained settlemententry. Retain recorded positions/pricingquantities ashistory withsettled=true;remaining liability0. Any different resolution/repeated new ID refuses;identical intent retry noops.

Structural malformed root/event fields,invalid numeric types/liquidity,duplicates account IDs,unsupported modes,nonfinite strings andbadchronology reject entire request withno partialresult. Syntacticallyvalid economic/protocol failures are accepted report events withdecision=rejected/reason andunchanged financialstate. Track unsuccessful actions separately fromsuccessful trades/settlement.

After each action assert cashconservation,nonnegative balances/positions,recorded positionsum=q,netcharges=Chat(q)-Chat(0),andworst modeled liability-loss<=funded reserve. Atsettlement paidtotal=q_winner;realizedmakerprofit=netcharges-paidtotal. Quotes/rejections/idempotent attempts havezero financialeffect. Rounded ledger equality isnot a claim that ln/exp are exact.

Canonical accounts byID;events preserve declaredorder. Market/account/input/schema/source/code/snapshot/ledger/report identities retained. Successful financialentries bindprevious entrySHA;economicrevision invalidates stale quotes even if round-trip quantities/cash return toearliervalues. Original request notmutated. Final prices afterresolution arehistorical modeldiagnostics,not executable quotes.
